name: amply
description: Artists host their own music, set their own prices, and are paid directly.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:manage && npm run build:licence && npm run build:app && npm run build:version
scripts.check: npm run build && node spec/validate.mjs spec/example.json && npm run test:manage && npm run test:app && npm run test:csp && npm run test:store && npm run test:page && npm run test:stripe && npm run test:sales && npm run test:limits && npm run test:pricing && npm run test:provision && npm --prefix node run typecheck && npm --prefix relay run typecheck
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && ./node/node_modules/.bin/wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=amply
scripts.test:pricing: node spec/test-pricing.mjs && node spec/test-domain.mjs && node spec/test-waves.mjs && node spec/test-colors.mjs
scripts.test:provision: node scripts/test-provision.mjs && node scripts/test-migrate.mjs && node scripts/test-access.mjs && node scripts/test-attach.mjs
scripts.build:version: node scripts/node-version.mjs && cp spec/manifest-rules.mjs site/js/manifest-rules.mjs && node scripts/security-headers.mjs
